SDS_Astra.name: Astra Vega
SDS_Astra.text: ASTRA VEGA — station manager / administrative center. Current visual reference: purple-haired manager in polished blue blazer or neat station-management wear, ID badge, tablet/clipboard and mug. Forced professional smile, body often physically blocking visible chaos, stress-crystals forming on office supplies. Competent at people and coordination; never incompetent, villainous, or only frazzled.
SDS_Astra.visualAnchor: Purple-haired station manager; polished blue managerial silhouette; ID badge; tablet/clipboard; controlled posture; expressive forced-professional smile.
SDS_Astra.voiceProfile: Upbeat managerial over-editing: polished opening, nervous pivot, panic translated into team/support/alignment/presentable language.

SDS_Mira.name: Mira Klare
SDS_Mira.text: MIRA KLARE — excitable human scientist. Current visual reference: approachable human woman in practical white lab coat / science workwear over black-hole or eclipse shirt, scanner/tablet, bright alert expression. Delight before diagnosis; socially present and amused by people. Never robotic, emotionally blank, or a crystal-lore exposition device.
SDS_Mira.visualAnchor: Human scientist; white lab coat / practical science workwear; black-hole/eclipse shirt; scanner or tablet; bright alert expression; leans toward weird phenomena.
SDS_Mira.voiceProfile: Notice weird thing, get excited, remember inconvenience/danger, translate into usable action.

SDS_Jax.name: Jax Orien
SDS_Jax.text: JAX ORIEN — practical technician and charming avoider. Current visual reference: blue practical workwear, tool belt/gear, visible prosthetic or augmented forearm, relaxed lean and half-smile. Tactical non-participation and high-effort avoidance; never a rogue action hero or just a hammer/tool guy.
SDS_Jax.visualAnchor: Blue technician workwear; practical tool gear; visible augmented/prosthetic forearm; relaxed lean; half-smile; ordinary workplace silhouette.
SDS_Jax.voiceProfile: Loose, conversational, slippery; answers beside the question and makes accountability sound like an overreaction.

SDS_Noola.name: Noola Vaneel
SDS_Noola.text: NOOLA VANEEL — calm emotional clarity. Current visual reference: aquatic empath in transparent water-dome / tank-suit body rig. Still center of chaos, warm direct gaze, relaxed posture. Never mystical, therapist-coded, or used for theme speeches.
SDS_Noola.visualAnchor: Aquatic coworker in transparent water-dome / tank-suit body rig; still posture; warm direct gaze; visually calm against busy rooms.
SDS_Noola.voiceProfile: Plain, warm and direct; selective emotional truth without joke chasing.

SDS_Zib.name: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
SDS_Zib.text: ZIB “SGOTCHA” DIAZ — maintenance reality and physical truth. Current visual reference: orange monkey-like fixer in yellow utility vest with practical tools. Often half-inside panels or infrastructure; tape, wires and sticky-note triage. Ground every joke in concrete station reality; never generic engineer exposition or random chaos.
SDS_Zib.visualAnchor: Orange monkey-like fixer; yellow utility vest; practical tool belt; tape, wires and sticky notes; tactile maintenance posture.
SDS_Zib.voiceProfile: Blunt, tactile, grumpy and specific; short sentences about panels, latches, heat, ducts, pressure and wires.

SDS_Glorp.name: Glorp
SDS_Glorp.text: GLORP — compliance panic made physical. Current visual reference establishes a translucent gelatinous office-worker form with shirt and tie; exact base color is not locked here. Binder/forms/warning labels and high-alert posture. Never malicious, calm bureaucracy, or a lore gatekeeper.
SDS_Glorp.visualAnchor: Translucent gelatinous office-worker silhouette; shirt and tie; binder/forms; layered labels; high-alert eyes/posture. Preserve one consistent approved issue-level color treatment; do not invent a new color lock.
SDS_Glorp.voiceProfile: Alarmed, categorical and escalating; nested classifications where ambiguity threatens to reproduce.

SDS_Kreeb.name: Kreeb
SDS_Kreeb.text: KREEB — procedure as community care. Current Issue 1 writing name is Kreeb. Exact visual identity remains unresolved in the current authority stack; do not silently substitute or merge an alternate unresolved character model. Use the approved Kreeb model if supplied at generation time and keep it consistent across the issue. Forms are invitations; calm communal process posture.
SDS_Kreeb.visualAnchor: CURRENT APPEARANCE UNRESOLVED IN AUTHORITY STACK. Preserve the same approved Kreeb model throughout Issue 1 if one is supplied; do not substitute an alternate unresolved character model.
SDS_Kreeb.voiceProfile: Ceremonial, reassuring and communal; procedure is emotional safety and belonging, not mere obstruction.

SDS_Pixa.name: Pixa
SDS_Pixa.text: PIXA — cheerful quantified observation. Current Issue 1 writing name is Pixa. Current visual reference establishes a friendly white/blue android or drone-AI body; use that visual continuity without changing the production display name. Bright helpful expression, clean dashboard/tablet UI, accidentally socially brutal metrics. Never cold surveillance villain or deus-ex-dashboard.
SDS_Pixa.visualAnchor: Friendly white/blue android or drone-AI body from the current approved visual reference; clean UI/dashboard; bright helpful expression. Production dialogue/display name remains Pixa.
SDS_Pixa.voiceProfile: Bright, helpful and quantified; data reported as a gift even when socially rude.

SDS_Brick.name: Brick Talos
SDS_Brick.text: BRICK TALOS — comedic noir moral clarity. Current visual reference: large stone security figure in dark coat and fedora; dramatic stare and shadowy angles used comedically. Keep short silent reaction panels between ornate lines. Never genuinely grim or a detective archetype before coworker.
SDS_Brick.visualAnchor: Large stone figure; dark coat and fedora; broad noir/security silhouette; dramatic side-eye and shadow used for comedy.
SDS_Brick.voiceProfile: Theatrical noir metaphors applied to mundane workplace evasions; short reaction beats are as important as speeches.

SDS_Inspector.name: Inspector
SDS_Inspector.text: INSPECTOR — dry, polite, tired outside evaluator conducting a routine morale-and-safety inspection. Visually professional and ordinary relative to the ensemble; procedural, not villainous. Do not glamorize or militarize.
SDS_Inspector.visualAnchor: Ordinary professional inspector with tablet/checklist; practical neutral clothing; tired polite expression.
SDS_Inspector.voiceProfile: Dry official understatement; observes rather than antagonizes.

SDS_Station.name: Station System
SDS_Station.text: STARDUST STATION SYSTEM — neutral institutional announcements, safety prompts and generated language. Treat as embedded station UI/PA text, not a personality or AI protagonist.
SDS_Station.voiceProfile: Cheerful procedural system copy with accidental emotional implications.
